lines.text: The Israelites struck down kings and took their lands east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon.
Sihon king of the Amorites lived in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan was one of the remnant of the Rephaim.
Moses and the Israelites struck down those kings and gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Aaron.
Caleb and the Israelites conquered the kings west of the Jordan, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak.
The kings listed include those of Jericho, Ai, Jerusalem, Hebron, Lachish, Hazor, and Tirzah, thirty-one kings in all.
